tHIS IS WHAT THE ROLE OF Logistics Employee AT HORCONEX LOOKS LIKE 
As a Logistics Employee, you ensure that materials are available on time for our projects. Over time, your role may expand to include: - Assigning transport orders to carriers - Maintaining contact with suppliers and carriers - Checking incoming transport invoices - Preparing export documentation for international transport
